sources.title: orangefabercastell/gemma-2-2b-it-pi-mono-sft · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Gemma 2 2B SFT on Agent Execution Traces Supervised fine-tuned Gemma 2 2B(google/gemma-2-2b-it/ unsloth/gemma-2-2b-it-bnb-4bit) trained on real-world autonomous coding-agent execution traces from badlogicgames/pi-mono. The model was adapted using 4-bit Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) with completion-only loss masking.
